# Copilot instructions

Read and follow **`AGENTS.md`** at the repository root. It is the single source of truth
for all agents (Copilot, Continue, Cline, and any other). This file is a pointer only —
do not add rules here.

If this file is all you remember of the contract, re-read `AGENTS.md` (its contract digest) and `rules/base.md` before your next action.
